items.item_text: Experience performing highly repetitive techniques pertaining to sterile culture, including separation of stock solutions and media.
Experience with and knowledge of tissue culture technology including microbiology and sterile technique.

Prepare standard media, reagents, and solutions both under supervision and independently. Transfer meristem-tip culture plants of FPS crops using standard protocols. Maintain a clean lab environment and assist laboratory personnel in miscellaneous projects.
40% - Perform Tissue Culture for FPS Crops
10% - Participate in Efforts to Maintain an Efficient Smooth-Running Department
Minimum of two years of college-level course work in related field of study.
Skills to produce and use inventory lists of transferred or transplanted plants to update the department computer database.
Knowledge of grape and strawberry micro-shoot tip culture.
Skills to record an inventory of work performed and label plant material.
